description: This file is a Python script used for creating and appending a flash image tag to a binary file. It defines functions for generating CRC32-based tags, processing input files, and command-line argument parsing for specifying tag parameters such as version, chip ID, flash type, and flags.

methods.name: auto_int(x)
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, auto-detecting hexadecimal notation.

methods.name: create_tag(args, in_bytes)
methods.description: Creates a binary tag containing CRC32 checksum and metadata based on provided arguments and input bytes.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads input file, generates a tag, and writes the original data with appended tag to the output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up argument parsing, validates arguments, and initiates tag creation process.
